scope: Post-open geometry-only mechanism attribution on the same thirteen supplied nine-camera calibrations and thirteen virtual-ring nine-camera rigs already opened by v208-v211. It reads no density, observation, reconstruction, residual, parent metric array, or reference field and is not a fresh external gate.
scientific_question: Does signed phase cancellation of the frozen low-frequency field family along reported rays strictly distinguish every virtual-ring nine-camera geometry that passed the frozen reference gate from every supplied nine-camera calibration that failed it, despite the reversed unsigned local-coverage result in v211?

supplied_nine_failing.reference_outcome: 0/13 complete calibration groups at the frozen zero-start CGLS K16 reference gate in v208

virtual_ring_nine_passing.reference_outcome: 13/13 complete rig groups at the same reference gate in v209

fixed_signed_line_quadrature.active_ray_rule: Represent every reported detector ray as an infinite line and retain its unique segment inside the declared axis-aligned reconstruction box. Parallel outside lines are rejected; endpoint ties use the closed box with float64 arithmetic.
fixed_signed_line_quadrature.quadrature: Use the 64 equal-length open midpoint samples of the clipped segment with segment_length/64 weights. This common analytic quadrature is used for both geometry families and is not either family's stored forward discretization.
fixed_signed_line_quadrature.field_family: Use exactly the 64 separable raw sine fields sin(pi*k0*q0)*sin(pi*k1*q1)*sin(pi*k2*q2), with k0,k1,k2 each in {1,2,3,4}, q in [0,1]^3 in array-axis order. The constant interior-mean subtraction in the v210 raw fields has zero gradient and therefore does not alter this diagnostic.
fixed_signed_line_quadrature.world_gradient: Differentiate the raw sine fields analytically in array coordinates, multiply by pi*k/span for each mapped world axis, and project the resulting world gradient onto the reported per-ray image-plane u and v unit vectors.
fixed_signed_line_quadrature.signed_component_integral: For each active ray, mode, and u/v observation component, coherent response is abs(sum_s gradient_component_s*segment_length/64). Its unsigned envelope is sum_s abs(gradient_component_s)*segment_length/64.
fixed_signed_line_quadrature.camera_weighting: Within each camera, average squared coherent responses and squared envelopes over all active rays, all 64 modes, and both u/v components. Average those two energies over active cameras so every camera has equal total weight, then take sqrt(total coherent energy/total envelope energy).
fixed_signed_line_quadrature.camera_permutation: Canonicalize cameras by a content signature of their clipped lines and image-plane bases. Reversing the input camera roster and ray order must leave all metrics within 1e-12.
fixed_signed_line_quadrature.orientation: Ray integration direction is sign-invariant. Reported u/v signs are retained, but the absolute coherent response and squared energy make the metric invariant to a simultaneous sign convention change of either image-plane basis vector.

unique_primary.name: signed_line_coherence_ratio
unique_primary.definition: sqrt(camera-balanced coherent squared energy divided by camera-balanced unsigned-envelope squared energy), bounded in [0,1]. Larger means less signed phase cancellation and therefore stronger usable low-mode response under this fixed analytic family.
unique_primary.strict_separation_gate: The minimum primary over all 13 virtual-ring nine-camera rigs must be strictly greater than the maximum primary over all 13 supplied nine-camera calibrations. Equivalently, all 169 cross-family comparisons must be strict wins.

preregistered_diagnostics_not_substitute.signed_line_coherent_rms: Square root of the camera-balanced coherent squared energy before division by the envelope.
preregistered_diagnostics_not_substitute.signed_line_envelope_rms: Square root of the camera-balanced unsigned-envelope squared energy.
preregistered_diagnostics_not_substitute.mode_coherence_minimum: Minimum of the same coherence ratio computed separately for each of the 64 fixed modes.
preregistered_diagnostics_not_substitute.mode_coherence_median: Median of the 64 fixed modewise coherence ratios.
preregistered_diagnostics_not_substitute.mode_coherence_maximum: Maximum of the 64 fixed modewise coherence ratios.
preregistered_diagnostics_not_substitute.virtual_twelve_camera_metrics: Cardinality diagnostic only and never a replacement primary.

execution_contract.offline_geometry_ray_samples: 64 times the independently reported active-ray count for each geometry

independent_validation.implementation: A second program may import frozen geometry builders but must not import the formal v212 runner. It must independently parse every calibration and reconstruct every virtual rig, independently clip lines, explicitly broadcast the 64 mode gradients without the formal contraction order, rebuild all 39 metrics, verify camera reversal, and confirm formal arrays and sealed inputs are unchanged.

decision_order: Any parent mismatch, source/input drift, prohibited scientific-array read, invalid line clip, non-finite or out-of-range ratio, zero envelope, missing geometry row, camera-permutation failure, formal-independent mismatch, or output mutation gives INCONCLUSIVE_INVALID_SIGNED_LINE_CANCELLATION_EXECUTION_V212.

If all 169 virtual-nine versus supplied-nine primary comparisons are strict wins, conclude PASS_SIGNED_LINE_CANCELLATION_STRICTLY_SEPARATES_CASE5_REFERENCE_V212. This is geometry-mechanism evidence on already opened synthetic data only.

Otherwise, if the virtual-nine primary median is strictly greater and pairwise superiority exceeds 0.5, conclude PARTIAL_OVERLAPPING_SIGNED_LINE_CANCELLATION_EVIDENCE_V212 and close this fixed scalar as an adequacy classifier.
Otherwise conclude FAIL_SIGNED_LINE_CANCELLATION_DOES_NOT_EXPLAIN_CASE5_REFERENCE_V212 and close this fixed signed-line cancellation scalar.

Diagnostics and virtual-twelve results may never replace the unique primary or upgrade a partial or negative result. No field family, quadrature, camera weighting, normalization, coordinate map, threshold, or decision rule may be changed after observing results.
